name: Extra Privilege
summary: Low-profile meta knowledge and hidden-route access.
description: A stealth privilege that grants insight into hidden routes, but demands subtle play to avoid detection.
coreLoop: Reveal hidden options during narrative events.
Exploit low-suspicion paths to gain rare rewards.
Balance visibility to preserve privilege strength.
progression: Privilege levels unlock deeper hidden routes.
narrativeHooks: System narration hints at unseen routes.
Rivals become aware if privilege exposure spikes.
questHooks: Complete a covert quest without detection.
Erase evidence to restore privilege level.

name: Class Unique Covenant
summary: Only you can wield a unique class path.
description: A covenant that grants a one-of-one class with exclusive skills and immunity to class theft.
coreLoop: Pass covenant trials to claim the class.
Unlock exclusive class laws.
Defend the covenant from usurpers.
progression: Covenant stages add personal class perks.
narrativeHooks: Usurpers attempt to steal your class seal.
questHooks: Complete a solo trial without allies.
Defeat a covenant challenger for a new sigil.

name: Information Vision Array
summary: See stats, weaknesses, and hidden routes.
description: An analysis array that surfaces enemy data, loot vectors, and secret paths in real time.
coreLoop: Scan targets to reveal stats and weaknesses.
Expose hidden routes and loot caches.
Exploit data for combat advantages.
progression: Information tiers reveal rare drop logic.
narrativeHooks: Enemies feel watched and adjust tactics.
questHooks: Identify a hidden weakness before a duel.
Map a secret route through a sealed zone.

name: Mind-Reading Exploit
description: A cognition exploit that reads surface intent and predicts actions during critical moments.
coreLoop: Focus to read intentions in combat.
Predict enemy actions before they trigger.
Exploit revealed motives for social leverage.
progression: Range and clarity improve with use.
narrativeHooks: NPCs react to your unsettling insight.
Telepaths attempt to block your exploit.
questHooks: Read a commander's intent to prevent an ambush.
Survive a duel against a mind shielded foe.

name: Villain POV Advantage
description: A privilege that unlocks intimidation, resource seizure, and plot disruption routes.
coreLoop: Exploit villain options in encounters.
Harvest fear and respect into power.
Invest infamy into dark perks.
questHooks: Seize a hero resource without being discovered.
Defeat a rival villain for a perk slot.

name: Danger Sense Array
summary: Auto-detect lethal threats before they land.
description: A sensor array that flags ambushes and grants evasive triggers during critical windows.
coreLoop: Detect lethal events in advance.
Trigger auto-evade charges.
Invest in sensors to widen warning windows.
questHooks: Survive an assassination attempt without damage.
Calibrate the array in a storm zone.

name: Instant Comprehension Grant
summary: Learn laws, languages, and techniques instantly, skipping decades of study.
description: A privilege that allows for the instantaneous understanding of complex information, from ancient languages to the fundamental laws of reality, by merely observing or touching them.
coreLoop: Encounter a new concept, text, or technique.
Trigger the 'Comprehension Grant' to instantly absorb and understand it.
Apply the newly learned knowledge immediately.
progression: Reduce the 'cooldown' or 'focus' required between comprehension grants.
Evolve the ability from simple understanding to 'Conceptual Assimilation', allowing you to modify the learned concept.
narrativeHooks: You become a polymath of impossible genius, but your rapid growth isolates you.
Guardians of ancient knowledge see you as a grave threat who bypasses their sacred traditions of slow learning.
questHooks: Instantly master a lost martial art mid-duel to defeat its last practitioner.
Decipher an entire library of alien text in seconds to avert a planetary disaster.
